manifest_row.title: The first step to conserving the Great Barrier Reef is understanding what lives there

screening.main_topic: Coral taxonomy and biodiversity research needed to conserve the Great Barrier Reef and guide restoration interventions.
screening.climate_relevance: The article discusses repeated mass bleaching, climate change as a threat to coral survival, and proposed interventions such as developing heat-tolerant corals. It argues that better knowledge of coral species is needed to assess the risks of those interventions.
